edits.old: and is the same value on every pool.
edits.new: and is the same value on every pool. The platform runs PgBouncer itself with one database or user entry per login, so the cap and the statement timeout are per login; the ACE DBA confirms this deployment shape before wave 1.

edits.old: and are held as configuration values, never as code.
edits.new: and are held as configuration values, never as code. The ACE DBA publishes, per login, the connection cap, pool size, pool mode, idle and connection timeouts and server-side reserve before the first release; the 5 s statement timeout stands on every pool.

edits.old: A migrator login owns nothing and is a member of no service login (AC4).
edits.new: A migrator login owns nothing and is a member of no service login (AC4). The ACE DBA creates each migrator login once per service, and its credential is held in the key store as a reference only (NFR-052).
